page.layout: One page of text; a decorative woodcut headpiece at top; title block centred; verse in two-line stanzas with a large initial at left; a catchword "Origi" at lower right margin (running word, treated as catchword).

main_text.head: IN THEODORI BEZÆ A'ξρaʓυσίαν A Io. Iacomoto versibus elegantissimis expositam.

p.i: Quàm rite factum! quàm bene, commodè,
Et ipsa ruptis, ô scelus, ô pudor,

page.notes: Woodcut initial "A" (decorated) at start of verse; the stanza lines are printed as continuous verse in the scan and are transcribed as one paragraph. Some words are uncertain in the Greek title and in the verse (e.g. "Acmóte", "Vnde") and should be checked against the original.
